capabilities: Format Fountain screenplays live as you type
Plan and reorder scenes via index cards and an outline sidebar
Export scripts to PDF with configurable paper size
Rehearse by blacking out a chosen character's dialogue
Create filtered script copies by removing dialogue, scenes, or element types
extras: Incompatible with the Custom File Extensions plugin when it is configured to handle .fountain files; the author warns the PDF export does not follow industry screenplay standards and points strict users to Highland Pro; the command reference is hosted outside the README.
intentEvidence: I ended up taking over the functionality of obsidian-fountain-editor as well.
motivation: The author built it because the previous Fountain plugin was gone and obsidian-fountain-editor only edits Markdown-tagged files, lacks a readonly view, and mishandles Fountain notes.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in support for writing or previewing Fountain screenplays, and its standard wiki links can't be used inside .fountain files.

relations.evidence: So at first I quickly threw together fountain-js and the css written by Bluemoondragon07
taking over the functionality of obsidian-fountain-editor as well

summary: Fountain screenplay editor that live-formats .fountain scripts and adds an index-card view, outline sidebar, PDF export, and rehearsal mode.
